Truck cab is white; front grille and bumper visible; appears to be a heavy-duty cab with off-road tyres.
Rig has a long lattice/boom structure extending upward and forward; multiple hydraulic/structural members visible.
No clear brand/model plate, engine hours, or control panel details are readable in the provided photos.
Photos show the machine outdoors on a dirt site; no close-ups of the drill head, bit, or working components.

claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show a truck-mounted drilling rig consistent with borehole drilling equipment.
No video/start-up/run test, no drilling footage, and no close-up of operational components.

claims.claim: only if u are a serious baya pls
claims.evidence: This is seller tone/intent; it does not confirm condition or specs.

risks.risk: Engine/drivetrain or hydraulic system may not be functional under load (photos only show the rig parked).
risks.proof: Short video of a cold start + hydraulic movement (boom/feeding) and a brief run of the drilling mechanism (bit rotation/rotation sound) on-site.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: needs repairs before use).

risks.risk: Drill head/bit/wear parts may be worn or missing, affecting drilling performance.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the drill head/bit and any cutting tools, plus a photo showing the bit size/condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worn/unknown wear (worst case: parts may need replacement).

risks.risk: Rig capacity/specs (depth, diameter range, mast/boom rating) are unknown; wrong capacity can make it overpriced.
risks.proof: Photo of the specification plate/manual page showing depth and hole diameter ranges (or a nameplate on the rig).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest/most conservative capacity assumption for a used truck-mounted rig.

risks.risk: Truck condition (gearbox, tyres, brakes, chassis) may be poor; rig may be usable but truck may be costly to maintain.
risks.proof: Video driving slowly on-site + close-up photos of tyres, brake area, and any visible leaks (hydraulic/fuel).
risks.if_unproven: Price as truck condition unknown (worst case: maintenance required).

risks.risk: Potential mismatch of what is included (spares, hoses, drill rods, power pack, tools) could reduce value.
risks.proof: Inventory list with photos of included items (drill rods, hoses, bits, tools, spare parts) laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Price as rig only (worst case: missing rods/tools/spares).

proof_requests: Send a short on-site video: cold start, hydraulic movements, and drilling/bit rotation demonstration.
Send close-up photos of the drill head/bit and any cutting tools (show wear/cracks).
Send photos of any specification plate/nameplate showing depth and hole diameter range.
Send photos of the truck chassis/engine bay and any visible leaks; include a slow-drive video.
Confirm what drill rods/tools/spares are included with photos and a checklist.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a truck-mounted borehole drilling rig, but the key value drivers (working condition under load, drill head/bit condition, and capacity/specs) are not verifiable remotely from these images. To price safely, we need proof of operation and the missing spec/condition details.
